# LadeCompile

> Free, no-login, enterprise-grade HTML/CSS/JS online compiler and live editor — part of the LadeStack suite.

LadeCompile lets any developer — from students to professionals — write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in a browser-based tabbed editor and see a live sandboxed preview instantly. No account. No signup. No paywall. Ever.

## What it is

- Three-file live editor: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `script.js` with syntax highlighting (Monaco) and debounced live preview via a sandboxed iframe (`srcdoc`).
- Console panel: captures `console.log`/`error` and runtime errors via a `postMessage` bridge.
- No-login save & share: code state is compressed and encoded into the URL hash (and short links via Cloudflare KV when the URL would be too long). Anyone with the link sees the same code.
- Export: ZIP download, copy to clipboard, and preview screenshot (PNG/JPEG) — all client-side.
- Templates library: starter boilerplates (landing page, portfolio, form) from a static list, with a confirm before overwriting unsaved changes.
- Dark/light theme toggle: CSS-variable / Tailwind dark mode, persisted in localStorage, respects `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit.
- AI quick actions (roadmap, not live in this build): Explain, Find bugs, Add comments, Optimize, Review — planned as free, rate-limited via Cloudflare KV, no paywall. Homepage marks them "Coming soon" so the claim stays honest.

## Why it exists

Existing playgrounds (OneCompiler, JSFiddle, CodePen, PlayCode) trade off: login required to save/share, AI help paywalled behind Upgrade, or dated UI with upsell. LadeCompile removes those trade-offs — it is a direct OneCompiler alternative for HTML that never gates features behind login or payment.

## Who it is for

Any developer who wants to write, test, debug, or prototype a quick HTML/CSS/JS snippet and optionally get help or share the result — without creating an account.

## Brand / suite

- Suite: LadeStack — free, no-login, AI-powered developer tools (sibling: GB Coder, a heavier AI code editor; LadeCompile is the lighter quick-snippet sibling).
- Domain (placeholder): https://compile.ladestack.in — real domain will replace this before launch.
- Hosting: Cloudflare Workers (Astro for `/` and `/blog/*`, Next.js via OpenNext for `/editor/*`, wrangler path-based routing).
- Repo: monorepo `apps/web` (Astro) + `apps/editor` (Next.js).
